_note: Topic sections for the published transcripts. Each label was drafted by READING the conversation arc of that episode, then anchored to the exact timestamp of a real turn where that topic starts. Labels describe what is actually discussed and are not generated: an automated attempt produced titles like 'Yes.' and 'Excellent.' because snapping to even time intervals lands on short reaction turns. If a label ever looks wrong, the turn it points at is the record; change the label, not the timestamp.
_why: Each episode page carries roughly 20,000 words of transcript under a single heading. Sectioning it gives the page many more topical entry points and anchor targets instead of one undifferentiated block.
